# Nirantara

> The Modern Task Runner

A fast, cross-platform build tool inspired by Make, designed for modern workflows.

## Table of Contents

### Documentation

- [Documentation](/docs.md): Task is a task runner and build tool that aims to be simpler and easier to use than GNU Make. Start here to install it, learn it, or look something up.
- [Guide](/docs/guide.md): Learn to define tasks, supply inputs, control execution, configure the environment and output, and include other Taskfiles.

#### Getting Started

- [Installation](/docs/installation.md): Installation methods for Task
- [Quick Start](/docs/getting-started.md): Guide for getting started with Task
- [Integrations](/docs/integrations.md): Official and community integrations for Task, including VS Code, JSON schemas, and other tools

#### Guide

##### Writing and running tasks

- [Defining tasks](/docs/guide/defining-tasks.md): Task syntax shortcuts, internal tasks, aliases, the directory a task runs in, and the help text Task shows for it.
- [Running tasks](/docs/guide/running-tasks.md): How Task finds a Taskfile, and how to run one from a subdirectory, from your home directory, from standard input or as a dry run.

##### Variables and arguments

- [Variables](/docs/guide/variables.md): Declare variables, compute values with shell commands, preserve types with references, and understand resolution order.
- [Command-line arguments](/docs/guide/arguments.md): Supply variables with NAME=value, forward arguments after --, and capture values with wildcard task names.
- [Validation and prompts](/docs/guide/required-variables.md): Require variables to be set, restrict them to allowed values, and prompt for missing input.
- [Secret variables](/docs/guide/secret-variables.md): Mask sensitive variable values in Task's command logs, load secrets from external sources, and understand what masking does not protect.

##### Task execution

- [Dependencies and task calls](/docs/guide/dependencies.md): Run checks before a build, put tasks in order, pass variables, and control repeated calls and cleanup.
- [Loops](/docs/guide/loops.md): Repeat a command over a static list, a matrix, a variable, your task's sources, or other tasks.
- [Conditional execution](/docs/guide/conditional-execution.md): Skip optional work with if, enforce requirements with preconditions, and ask for confirmation before execution with prompt.
- [Errors and cleanup](/docs/guide/errors-and-cleanup.md): Continue after selected command failures with ignore_error, schedule cleanup with defer, and inspect a failed command's exit code.
- [Up-to-date checks](/docs/guide/up-to-date.md): Skip unchanged builds, check whether work is already done, and choose between source fingerprints and status commands.
- [Watch mode](/docs/guide/watch.md): Re-run a task automatically whenever its sources change.

##### Environment and output

- [Environment variables](/docs/guide/environment.md): Set environment variables on a single task or on every task, and load them from `.env` files.
- [Platforms and shells](/docs/guide/platforms.md): Restrict tasks and commands to an operating system or architecture, and set shell options with `set` and `shopt`.
- [Output and logging](/docs/guide/output.md): Choose an output mode, hide command echoes, and display colors and failure annotations in CI.

##### Including Taskfiles

- [Including Taskfiles](/docs/guide/includes.md): Reuse tasks across projects with `includes`, covering namespaces, optional and internal includes, flattening, and per-include variables.
- [Remote Taskfiles](/docs/remote-taskfiles.md): Guide to loading and securely using Taskfiles from HTTP and Git sources

#### Reference

- [Taskfile Schema Reference](/docs/reference/schema.md): A reference for the Taskfile schema
- [Command Line Interface Reference](/docs/reference/cli.md): Complete reference for Task CLI commands, flags, and exit codes
- [Templating Reference](/docs/reference/templating.md): Comprehensive guide to Task's templating system with Go text/template, special variables, and available functions
- [Environment Reference](/docs/reference/environment.md): A reference for the Taskfile environment variables
- [Configuration Reference](/docs/reference/config.md): Complete reference for the Task config files and env vars
- [Package API Reference](/docs/reference/package.md): A reference for Task's Golang package API

#### Project

- [Changelog](/docs/changelog.md): Release history for Task, including new features, improvements, fixes, and breaking changes
- [FAQ](/docs/faq.md): Frequently asked questions about Task, including ETAs, shell limitations, and Windows compatibility
- [Taskfile Versions](/docs/taskfile-versions.md): How to use the Taskfile schema version to ensure users are using the correct versions of Task
- [Community](/docs/community.md): Task community contributions, installation methods, and integrations maintained by third parties
- [Experiments](/docs/experiments.md): Guide to Task’s experimental features and how to use them
- [Deprecations](/docs/deprecations.md): Guide to deprecated features in Task and how to migrate to the new alternatives
- [Security](/docs/security.md): How to report Task security vulnerabilities and how the project responds to them

##### Experiments

- [Env Precedence (#1038)](/docs/experiments/env-precedence.md): Experiment to change the precedence of environment variables in Task
- [Gentle Force (#1200)](/docs/experiments/gentle-force.md): Experiment to modify the behavior of the --force flag in Task
- [Remote Taskfiles (#1317)](/docs/experiments/remote-taskfiles.md): Experimentation for using Taskfiles stored in remote locations

##### Deprecations

- [Completion Scripts](/docs/deprecations/completion-scripts.md): Deprecation of direct completion scripts in Task’s Git directory
- [Template Functions](/docs/deprecations/template-functions.md): Deprecation of some templating functions in Task, with guidance on their replacements.
- [Version 2 Schema (#1197)](/docs/deprecations/version-2-schema.md): Deprecation of Taskfile schema version 2 and migration to version 3

##### Security

- [Incident Response Plan](/docs/security/incident-response-plan.md): Task's process for detecting, triaging, mitigating, and disclosing security incidents
- [Threat Model](/docs/security/threat-model.md): Threats, assets, trust boundaries, and mitigations for the Task project and its release infrastructure

#### Contributing

- [Contributing](/docs/contributing.md): Comprehensive guide for contributing to the Task project, including setup, development, testing, and submitting PRs
- [Style Guide](/docs/styleguide.md): Official style guide for Taskfile.yml files with best practices and recommended conventions
- [Releasing](/docs/releasing.md): Task release process including GoReleaser, Homebrew, npm, Snapcraft, winget, and other package managers

### Other

- [Task documentation for coding agents](/agents.md): A compact map of Task's documentation, plus the execution semantics that are easiest to get wrong when generating a Taskfile.
